The Bulldogs played their home games at [[Hinkle Fieldhouse]] in [[Indianapolis|Indianapolis, Indiana]], as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 14–18, 6–14 in Big East play to finish in ninth place.
